sc_newsletter.popup_subtitle: Invite your website visitors to subscribe to your newsletter.
sc_newsletter.subscribers_subtitle: The people who left their email on your website.
sc_newsletter.load_error: We couldn't load this section. Reload the page.
sc_newsletter.forbidden: Only the organization's admins can see this section.

popup.enabled_label: Show the pop-up on the website
popup.enabled_hint: If you turn it off, the pop-up stops appearing. The footer form stays available.
popup.privacy_hint: Appears under the button, next to a link to your privacy policy. You can leave it empty.
popup.delay_hint: 0 = it appears as soon as the page opens.
popup.days_hint: If someone closes it, they won't see it again for this many days. If they subscribe, they won't see it again in that browser.
popup.test_hint: To see it again in your browser after closing it, open the website in a private window.
popup.saved: Changes saved. They're already live on the website.
popup.save_error: We couldn't save the changes. Try again.
popup.restored: Suggested texts restored. Save to apply them.
popup.error_range: Enter a whole number between {{min}} and {{max}}.

resend.on: New subscribers are copied to your Resend contacts. From Resend → Broadcasts you can send them the newsletter; Resend adds the unsubscribe link.
resend.off: Resend isn't configured in this environment. Emails are saved here and stay unsynced.

preview.title: Preview
preview.disabled_note: The pop-up is off: it doesn't appear on the website.
preview.approx_note: Approximate preview: on the website it uses the site's colors and fonts.

subscribers.export_error: We couldn't export the list. Try again.
subscribers.empty_body: When someone leaves their email on your website, it will show up here.
subscribers.delete_title: Remove this email from the newsletter?
subscribers.delete_body: {{email}} will be removed from this list and, if it was synced, from your Resend contacts too. This can't be undone.
subscribers.deleted_local_only: It was removed from the list, but we couldn't remove it from Resend. Delete it there too.
subscribers.delete_error: We couldn't delete the email. Try again.
